scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Publish closed contact-history, marking-domain or observable-method evidence with explicit scope.

all_original_common_point_fields.scope: Compare independently audited covered CAD egg fields at identical physical times; geometry and contact axes remain coupled.
all_original_common_point_fields.limitations: Two covered meshes approximate the same declared CAD geometry at fixed material/density, friction, original held closure/control and physical timestep. Represented volume/mass and geometry differ explicitly. Bulk, surface geometry and body contact trace vary together; this is not a separated axis or a physical tail. Separate all-five-state audits qualify original force gates. Full raw corner/global bounds, objective common-point tensors and source arrays remain intact. This short stationary window does not establish complete original application, contact/space/regularization convergence, model/feedback or warmed accuracy/cost.

broad_five_state_audit.scope: Independently verify every precision-aware spatial state and its unaveraged global field.
broad_five_state_audit.limitations: Every original dynamic step is independently reconstructed, including exact previous-state/velocity integration, unsmoothed centered normal/friction stencils, mass/armature and capped jaw PD. Raw global wide-coordinate field bounds remain visible. The original fixed-arm/two-jaw control and saved held initializer remain explicit. Full-arm application matching and physical spatial/contact/geometry convergence are separate incomplete requirements.

broad_contact_coverage.scope: Locate independently audited contact samples relative to fixed numerical refinement caps.
broad_contact_coverage.limitations: Reference contact-sample positions are mapped to the same angular parameter used for numerical mesh marking; this is not a geodesic distance or resolved physical contact boundary. Unsigned sample-force norms avoid cancellation of opposing jaws and are not a traction-area integral. Incident trace edges are measured in the undeformed collision discretization. Samples outside caps reveal coverage gaps; samples inside caps do not exclude missed contact caused by coarse geometry elsewhere. No stress smoothing, force/geometry modification, convergence acceptance or original goal completion follows.
